dashboards.name: health_dashboard
queries: index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:health | stats latest(root_free_percent) as value
index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:health | head 1 | eval value=coalesce(mvcount('failed_units{}'),0) | table value
index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:health | stats latest(upgradable_package_count) as value
index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:health | table _time host root_free_percent failed_units{} upgradable_package_count reboot_required inspection_errors{} | sort - _time
index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:audit event_type=closure | table _time host run_id change_id status closing_remark | sort - _time

index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:audit event_type=software [ search index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:audit event_type=inventory earliest=-30d | stats latest(run_id) as run_id by host | fields host run_id ] | dedup host location name | table _time host name software_version software_source location update_policy
index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:health | dedup host | table _time host installed_package_count extra_software_count inspection_errors{}

index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:audit event_type=container [ search index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:audit event_type=container_inventory earliest=-30d | stats latest(run_id) as run_id by host | fields host run_id ] | dedup host name | table _time host name image_ref image_id application_version dependency_version running health update_policy
dashboards.title: AI Sysadmin - Server Health

dashboards.name: anomaly_dashboard
queries: index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:anomaly earliest=-7d | stats count as value
index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:anomaly earliest=-30d | timechart count by severity

index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:anomaly | table _time host severity message run_id action container reason error backup name package_version installed_version location locations{} errors{} failed_units{} observed threshold | sort - _time
dashboards.title: AI Sysadmin - Anomalies

dashboards.name: ignored_dashboard
queries: index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:ignored [ search index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:ignored earliest=-30d | stats latest(run_id) as run_id by host | fields host run_id ] | stats dc(software) as value

index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:ignored status=update_available_ignored [ search index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:ignored earliest=-30d | stats latest(run_id) as run_id by host | fields host run_id ] | stats dc(software) as value

index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:ignored status=not_detected [ search index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:ignored earliest=-30d | stats latest(run_id) as run_id by host | fields host run_id ] | stats dc(software) as value

index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:ignored [ search index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:ignored earliest=-30d | stats latest(run_id) as run_id by host | fields host run_id ] | dedup host software | table _time host software status installed_versions{} candidate_versions{} sources{} locations{} reason policy_file policy_sha256 run_id | sort host software
index=ai_sysadmin sourcetype=ai_sysadmin:ignored | table _time host software status installed_versions{} candidate_versions{} reason policy_sha256 run_id | sort - _time
dashboards.title: AI Sysadmin - Ignored Software
